scope: Requested-byte admission for the preallocated RetiredMemory catalog inside queued IPC MemoryAttachments. Original requester class, caps, full allocated capacity, remaining retirement owners and charge stay in one inert owner through queueing, delivery and FIFO child handoff. Capability-ID, transfer and loan vectors remain separate work.
artifact_note: Runtime Rust sources were frozen before native campaigns. Later documentation changes affect tracked-diff hashes; source and archived artifact hashes identify exercised code. SDK/service sources and the 23-pool/version-10 payload are unchanged; existing signed service bundles were reused and each runner regenerated signed security fixtures.

policy.charge: [caps.len() * size_of(RetiredMemory), 0], reserved before allocation; exact capacity checked, no later growth
policy.decision: Keep all numerical defaults. One maximum catalog requests about 33.9 KiB; real ordinary/total capacity pressure and public lifecycle controls pass in the existing 12/16 MiB pool. Catalogs compete with node layouts for same-class bytes but contribute no node slots. The earlier node-only sizing plan excludes catalogs. Inline reservation fields enlarge queued-message slots under their existing slot budget. Larger limits permit more retained heap consumption; measured mixed workloads can justify central byte/count adjustment. No simultaneous RAM-fit or essential-service fairness guarantee.

ownership.class: Calls use the original PreparedCall record classification. Sends capture trusted state against the exact sender namespace generation before acquiring/revalidating root leases and retain that boolean. Receiver identity, promotion and ASID reuse cannot select a later class or refund target.
ownership.construction: The constructor owns caps and original byte reservation before the fallible retirement-vector allocator. Nonempty exact capacity is admitted in full; empty catalogs allocate/reserve nothing. Allocated constructor rejection frees the buffer before refund. Errors remain IpcError::ResourceLimit. Input capability-ID allocation is not covered by this charge.
ownership.ordinary_cleanup: Call publication failure retains prepared catalog storage in CallResources until explicit finish after IPC unlock. ReceiveResources retains delivered catalog storage across guard exit before explicit disposal. Scalar-send finish and ordinary vector-send rejection dispose after local IPC guards; exact roots remain held through the containing operation.
ownership.handoff: release_with moves caps, original charge and an IntoIter into one inert Releasing owner. FIFO callback order is preserved. Full capacity/charge remains until every callback returns and the actual iterator buffer is deallocated. Interrupted callbacks retain all remaining retirement owners plus allocation/charge. Children consume their existing typed retirement owner, including terminal physical retention; parent metadata disposal is no physical completion or replay proof.
ownership.fallback: MemoryAttachments uses ManuallyDrop storage. Complete copied-call and single-send fixtures retain catalogs under the pool guard. A new storage-only ReceiveResources fixture retains one empty catalog and original charge under IPC/heap/pool guards, adopting no physical backing or authority.
